title: Jubilant Crispy German Collard Flatbread
description: A yeasty, shattering German flatbread with sautéed collards and a tangy mustard drizzle, perfect for a diabetic-friendly feast.
instructions: Combine the bread flour, whole wheat flour, yeast, and salt in a large bowl until evenly mixed.
Add the warm water and olive oil and stir until a shaggy dough forms.
Transfer the dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover, and let it ferment at room temperature for 12 hours.
After fermentation, punch down the dough and roll it into a flat rectangle about 3 mm thick.
Heat a large cast‑iron skillet over medium heat and lightly brush it with olive oil.
Slide the rolled dough into the skillet and cook for 3 minutes until golden brown spots appear.
Flip the flatbread and cook for an additional 2 minutes, then remove from heat.
Meanwhile, sauté the collard greens in a separate pan with a splash of olive oil until wilted, then mix in mustard, cheese, and dill.
Spread the collard mixture over the cooked flatbread and serve hot.
